# Job Up (jobup.ge)

> Job Up is a Georgian-language job search platform for Georgia. It aggregates active vacancies from Jobs.ge, HR.ge, Awork.ge, Myjobs.ge and LinkedIn in one place, updated daily, and offers an AI agent that matches a user's CV to new vacancies and notifies them via Telegram or email.

Language: Georgian (ka). Coverage: Georgia (Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi, Rustavi and other cities, plus remote and abroad roles).

## Main pages
- [All vacancies](https://jobup.ge/vacancies): searchable list of all active vacancies with filters for city, category and work type.
- [About Job Up and the AI job agent](https://jobup.ge/home): how CV matching and notifications work.

## Browse by city
- [Jobs in Tbilisi](https://jobup.ge/vacancies/tbilisi)
- [Jobs in Batumi](https://jobup.ge/vacancies/batumi)
- [Jobs in Kutaisi](https://jobup.ge/vacancies/kutaisi)
- [Jobs in Rustavi](https://jobup.ge/vacancies/rustavi)
- [Jobs abroad](https://jobup.ge/vacancies/abroad)

## Browse by work type
- [Remote work](https://jobup.ge/vacancies/remote)
- [Part-time work](https://jobup.ge/vacancies/part-time)
- [Internships](https://jobup.ge/vacancies/internship)

## Vacancy pages
Each vacancy has its own page at https://jobup.ge/vacancies/<title-company-id> with the role, company, location, deadline, salary when published, and a link to apply. Vacancies carry schema.org JobPosting markup. The full list of current vacancy URLs is in https://jobup.ge/sitemap.xml.
